items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 9 at 1:28AM AKDT until May 9 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* WHERE...Annette Island.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM AKDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 8 at 9:04PM AKDT until May 9 at 9:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is possible.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim River near McGrath.

* WHEN...Through Saturday evening.

* IMPACTS...Flooding possible in McGrath.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- The Kuskokwim River was moving normally at 7 PM, but appeared
to stop moving around 8 PM at the south end of town. Water
levels have not started rising yet, but an ice jam may result
in flooding tonight.

- Http://www.weather.gov/aprfc
items.instruction:
If you live near or along the Kuskokwim River at McGrath stay alert
and be prepared to take action.

Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 8 at 4:53PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Yukon Flats

The Yukon River breakup front was 28 miles downstream of Fort Yukon
on Thursday afternoon.  Several large ice runs from the ice jams
below Dawson have cleared Eagle and will be making their way past
Circle and Ft. Yukon today and tomorrow.  Water level rises are
expected with these ice runs, but no flooding.

items.description:

* WHEN...Until noon AKDT Sunday.

bends below Chalkyitsik and looks like it will remain in place for
